concerns.text: FR-014 (Power Analysis) is required by the specification but no task in tasks.md addresses power‑analysis computation or reporting.
SC-009 (Power analysis verification) is a success criterion with no corresponding task; the pipeline lacks any implementation or test for verifying statistical power.
SC-004 mandates a total runtime ≤ 6 h (including bootstrap) but tasks.md contains no benchmark or timing task to measure and enforce this constraint.
FR-011 requires exclusion of samples with missing thermal conductivity values and logging of exclusions, yet no task explicitly implements or tests this filtering step.

Constitution Principle I demands that all stochastic processes (synthetic data generation, bootstrap resampling, any random sampling) use pinned random seeds, but tasks.md lacks any task that sets or records these seeds.
